map.Ac > 1 判为正异常、< 1 为负异常；强度 ≥ 2 为强异常，≥ 1.5: Ac > 1 is judged a positive anomaly and < 1 a negative one; a strength of >= 2 is a strong anomaly, >= 1.5 medium, >= 1 weak, otherwise it falls within the background range.
map.→ 打开化探异常衬度计算工具: -> Open the geochemical anomaly contrast calculator tool
map.剖面解释：沿测线逐点算衬度，圈定异常中心与浓集中心: Profile interpretation: compute the contrast point by point along the survey line to delineate the anomaly centre and the concentration centre
map.化探异常衬度计算 使用指南: How to use the geochemical anomaly contrast calculator
map.在背景近似正态分布时，约 95% 的背景点落在均值±2σ 内，超出即视为统计异常: When the background is approximately normal, about 95% of the background points fall within mean ± 2σ, and anything beyond that is a statistical anomaly. If the background is clearly skewed, use the median plus a multiple or iteratively remove high values and recalculate, so that ore-caused high values are not absorbed into the background and raise the lower threshold.
map.异常下限为什么用 B+2σ？: Why is the anomaly threshold B+2σ?
map.异常分级：用异常下限与强度判定弱/中/强异常，指导验证排序: Anomaly grading: use the anomaly threshold and the intensity to classify weak, medium and strong anomalies, guiding the verification order
map.异常筛选：由背景值与异常值算衬度系数，快速识别正/负异常: Anomaly screening: compute the contrast coefficient from the background and anomaly values to quickly identify positive and negative anomalies
map.衬度 Ac=C/B 反映相对背景的倍比；强度=C/T 以异常下限为基准，更能指示: The contrast Ac=C/B shows the ratio to the background, while the intensity C/T is based on the anomaly threshold and better indicates how strongly the anomaly is enriched above that threshold. Together they distinguish "high overall but weak" from "locally very strong" anomalies.
map.衬度和强度有什么区别？: What is the difference between contrast and intensity?
map.衬度系数 Ac = 异常值 / 背景值；异常下限 T = 背景值 + 2 × 标: Contrast coefficient Ac = anomaly value / background value; anomaly threshold T = background value + 2 × standard deviation; anomaly intensity = anomaly value / T
map.输入背景值、异常值（及可选标准差），计算衬度系数、富集系数、异常下限与异常强度: Enter the background value, the anomaly value (and optionally the standard deviation) to compute the contrast coefficient, the enrichment coefficient, the anomaly threshold and the anomaly intensity
map.：例：背景 B=40μg/g、异常 C=120μg/g、σ=10 → Ac=12: : example: background B=40 μg/g, anomaly C=120 μg/g, σ=10 -> Ac=120/40=3.000, threshold T=40+2×10=60, intensity=120/60=2.000, judged a "strong anomaly" (a clear concentration centre). With B=30, C=90, σ=10 -> Ac=3.000, T=30+20=50, intensity=90/50=1.800, judged a "medium anomaly".
map.：算法：衬度系数 Ac = 异常值 C / 背景值 B；异常下限 T = B +: : algorithm: contrast coefficient Ac = anomaly C / background B; anomaly threshold T = B + 2σ (σ is the standard deviation, taken as 0 if not filled in); anomaly intensity = C / T; enrichment coefficient = C / B. Decision: Ac>1 positive anomaly, <1 negative; intensity >=2 strong, >=1.5 medium, >=1 weak, otherwise background range.
